result.brief: 提出 ReLaDrift：用共享 Drifting 模型从噪声生成初稿并在连续潜空间迭代精炼，通过采样轮数、仅在末轮施加 drifting 损失并截断梯度训练，实现语言生成的测试时计算扩展。
result.reason: Recurrent drifting model refining drafts in continuous latent space for language generation, enabling test-time compute scaling; directly a continuous latent language modeling contribution.
